notes: `כְּגֶפֶן פֹּרִיָּה` is the predicate of a verbless clause, so the construction-supplied copula *shall be* joins the comparative preposition and the unit heads on *as* under rule 49; the parallel colon `כִּשְׁתִלֵי זֵיתִים` gaps its copula and the ASV writes none, so nothing further is placed there under rules 34 and 49.

`יַרְכְּתֵי` → *the innermost parts* is headed on *innermost* under rule 31. The competing reading heads on the class noun *parts*; that was set aside because the ASV does not write *parts* alone for this word, so *parts* is the supplied generic and *innermost* carries the lexeme.

`סָבִיב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶךָ` follows rule 40's `סָבִיב` ruling exactly: the compound *Round about* belongs whole to the adverb, headed on *Round*, and the `לְ` is `unrepresented` because the ASV spends no word on its own relation.
`שְׁתִלֵי זֵיתִים` → *olive plants* is rendered attributively under rule 28, so no *of* is written for the chain and rule 19 has nothing to place.
